lede: Let AI agents use your real iPhone. With iphone-use installed on your Mac, Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client reads the phone's screen as text, taps, types and swipes in any app, including the ones with no API: Health, banking, chat apps, or the app you are testing. You can watch it live and take the phone back at any time.
